answer: Histories are stored in velvet, checked in saffron, and lantern shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3808 identities would post 829 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
